trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes. You can try every feature for 7 days before choosing a plan.

yearlyDiscount.question: Does the annual plan have a discount?
yearlyDiscount.answer: Yes. With annual billing you get 1 month free: Essentials is €605/year and Growth is €825/year, excluding VAT.

growthDifference.question: What's the difference with Growth?

commissions.question: Are there commissions per reservation?

billing.question: What about tax invoicing?
billing.answer: Tax invoicing is handled externally by a certified software of your choice. That cost isn't charged by MesaLink.

service.title: 1. Service
service.text: MesaLink is an online platform for restaurant reservation management, including a public reservations page, calendar, customers, QR Code and operational tools.

usage.title: 2. Use
usage.text: The user agrees to provide truthful information and to use the platform only for lawful purposes related to managing their restaurant.

payments.title: 3. Payments
payments.text: Paid plans are billed monthly or annually, as selected. Prices shown do not include VAT unless stated otherwise.

partnerNetwork.title: 3-A. Partner Network and commissions
partnerNetwork.text: In the Partner Network, professional partners can submit group requests with the contact details needed for the booking. Before acceptance, restaurants see only the code, date, party size and preferences; the contact is revealed only to the restaurant that authorises the card and secures the booking. After the service, 15% of the gross commission belongs to MesaLink and 85% is payable to the partner. The partner must invoice the restaurant and attach the PDF to the group. Weekly payment is processed only after MesaLink verifies that invoice. Service and processing fees are shown before checkout. Cancellations, no-shows, refunds, invoicing and taxes follow the applicable agreement and law.

cancellation.title: 4. Cancellation
cancellation.text: The customer may cancel their subscription. Access to the service may remain available until the end of the period already paid for.

liability.title: 5. Liability
liability.text: MesaLink is not responsible for incorrect information entered by the restaurant, external internet outages, third-party services, or misuse of the platform.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.text: For questions related to these terms, contact:

dataCollected.title: 1. Data we collect
dataCollected.text: We may collect data such as name, email, phone number, restaurant information, reservations created, schedules, customers and data necessary to use the platform.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose
purpose.text: Data is used to provide the MesaLink service, process reservations, manage accounts, communicate with users and improve the platform.

customerData.title: 3. Restaurant customers' data
customerData.text: End customers' data is used only to manage reservations and communications related to those reservations.

dataSharing.title: 4. Data sharing
dataSharing.text: We do not sell personal data. We may use third-party services necessary for hosting, payments, authentication, email or technical support.

partnerNetwork.title: 4-A. Partner Network data
partnerNetwork.text: Group requests use a code plus the date, party size, area, budget, preferences and contact details needed for the booking. Access controls hide the name, phone number and email from restaurants before acceptance; they become available only to the restaurant that secures the booking. Stripe processes restaurant and partner tax and payment data for verification, charges, invoicing and transfers. Partner invoices remain attached to the group history and are available only to the partner, the recipient restaurant and authorised MesaLink staff.

rights.text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data via email:

security.title: 6. Security
security.text: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect the data processed on the platform.
